Nested mapping of owner=>spender=>amount allowances.
Total token supply, hardcoded in the HSO constructor.

Token name string set by ERC20Detailed constructor.
Token symbol string set by ERC20Detailed constructor.
Token decimals (16) set by ERC20Detailed constructor.
Public transfer that forwards _msgSender() as sender to _transfer.
Public transferFrom that moves tokens and decrements allowance via SafeMath sub.
Public approve that sets allowance for _msgSender().
Public increaseAllowance adding to existing allowance.
Public decreaseAllowance subtracting from existing allowance.
Internal _transfer that validates addresses and mutates _balances.
Internal _approve that validates addresses and writes _allowances.
Context._msgSender returning msg.sender as the authenticated caller.
SafeERC20 helper that performs a raw low-level call to an arbitrary token address.
SafeERC20 wrapper that encodes transfer selector and calls callOptionalReturn.
SafeERC20 wrapper that encodes transferFrom selector and calls callOptionalReturn.
SafeERC20 wrapper that checks allowance then calls callOptionalReturn.
Address library helper using inline assembly extcodehash to test for contract code.
HSO constructor that sets admin, total supply and initial balance.
ERC20Detailed constructor initializing _name, _symbol and _decimals.
Public view returning the balance of an account.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for admin and ownership checks.
Raw address(token).call(data) external call whose target and calldata are supplied by callers; classic reentrancy vector.
Inline assembly extcodehash used to detect contracts.
Supply computation 420000000 * 10**18 while decimals are declared as 16, an inconsistent arithmetic scaling.
Allowance subtraction performed for transferFrom/decreaseAllowance.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin directly from msg.sender, making the caller privileged.
Entire total supply is minted to the msg.sender-controlled admin address.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender, which backs all ownership checks.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the token sender.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance checks.
transfer delegates state mutation to internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates state mutation to internal _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the spender allowance.
approve delegates to internal _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to internal _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to internal _approve.
HSO constructor invokes the ERC20Detailed constructor.
safeTransfer forwards encoded calldata to callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom forwards encoded calldata to callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove forwards encoded calldata to callOptionalReturn.
callOptionalReturn verifies the target is a contract via isContract.
callOptionalReturn executes the external low-level call that can re-enter the contract.
isContract performs inline assembly extcodehash.
A malicious token invoked by the low-level call can re-enter public transferFrom before allowance/balance state settles.
A malicious token invoked by the low-level call can re-enter public transfer.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
_transfer writes sender and recipient entries in _balances.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the caller allowance in _allowances.
Constructor sets _totalSupply.
Constructor writes the privileged admin state variable.
Constructor credits the full supply to the admin in _balances.
ERC20Detailed constructor sets _name.
ERC20Detailed constructor sets _symbol.
ERC20Detailed constructor sets _decimals.
Supply literal 420000000 * 10**18 is used although decimals are 16, an arithmetic scaling mismatch.
transferFrom subtracts the spent amount from the allowance.
decreaseAllowance subtracts the requested value from the allowance.

value parameter feeds the encoded transfer calldata.
spender parameter feeds safeApprove.
value parameter feeds safeApprove.
success flag captures the result of the low-level call.
returndata is decoded to validate the ERC20 operation result.
codehash receives the extcodehash assembly result.
accountHash is compared with codehash to detect EOAs.
